rows.selection_reason: The existing evidence is sparse, so this experiment tests a promising multimodal configuration using scvi_n200 (advanced RNA encoder) and resnet50 (standard image encoder) with weighted fusion, which balances exploration of encoder combinations and fusion methods. This configuration addresses key design choices (encoder types, fusion strategy) that significantly impact performance, providing foundational insights for subsequent exploitation of effective configurations.

The existing evidence shows config_026 (multimodal, scvi_n200 RNA, resnet50 image, weighted fusion) achieves 54% accuracy. This experiment tests replacing the RNA encoder with scgpt while keeping resnet50 and weighted fusion, clarifying if RNA encoder choice significantly impacts performance. It balances exploration of critical components (RNA encoder) with consistency in other parameters, prioritizing uncertainty reduction about key design choices.

The existing evidence shows that using scvi_n200 RNA encoder with resnet50 image encoder (config_026) achieves higher accuracy than scgpt (config_028). This experiment tests replacing resnet50 with imagenet_vit_l (a stronger image encoder) while keeping scvi_n200 RNA encoder and weighted fusion, which could improve performance. It directly builds on the current best setup to explore a critical design choice (image encoder) with minimal changes.

The existing evidence shows that config_026 (scvi_n200 RNA, resnet50 image, weighted fusion) has the highest validation accuracy (0.5399). This experiment tests scvi_n200 RNA with imagenet_vit_l image and concat fusion, which could clarify if the image encoder or fusion method is critical. It balances exploration by testing a related configuration with a different image encoder and fusion approach, potentially improving upon the current top performer.

The existing evidence shows that scvi_n200 RNA encoder with resnet50 image encoder (config_026) achieves the highest accuracy so far (0.5399). This experiment tests pca_n2000 RNA encoder with resnet50 image encoder, comparing the impact of RNA encoder choice while keeping the image encoder and fusion method consistent. It clarifies whether pca_n2000 could improve or degrade performance, balancing exploration of RNA encoder alternatives with exploitation of the proven image encoder.

The existing evidence shows that using scvi_n200 and resnet50 with weighted fusion (config_026) achieves the highest accuracy so far. This experiment tests the same RNA and image encoders but with concat fusion, clarifying whether the fusion method impacts performance. It balances exploitation of the current top-performing setup with exploration of alternative fusion strategies, maximizing the chance of finding a better configuration within the remaining budget.

Existing evidence shows scvi_n200 + resnet50 with weighted fusion achieves ~0.54 accuracy on singleprofile. This experiment tests applying transformer aggregation (a novel component in top performers) to multiprofile data, which could leverage scvi_n200's RNA encoding strength while exploring aggregation methods that might better handle multiprofile complexity. It balances exploitation of proven components with exploration of aggregation methods critical for multiprofile performance.

Existing evidence shows config_020 (multimodal multiprofile with transformer aggregation and weighted fusion) achieves the highest accuracy (0.713). This experiment tests pca_n2000 RNA encoder + imagenet_vit_l image encoder with the same effective parameters, exploring if combining these encoders with transformer aggregation could further improve performance. It clarifies whether the RNA/image encoder choice impacts results when using the proven aggregation/fusion strategy, balancing exploitation of known effective components with exploration of encoder combinations.

The existing evidence shows config_020 (multiprofile, scvi_n200, resnet50, transformer, weighted) achieves the highest accuracy (0.713). This experiment tests replacing resnet50 with imagenet_vit_l (a stronger image encoder) and switching fusion from weighted to concat, which could improve performance. It clarifies whether the image encoder or fusion method is the limiting factor, and exploits the multiprofile setting's proven effectiveness.

The existing evidence shows that configurations using multiprofile settings with scvi_n200 RNA encoder and imagenet_vit_l image encoder (e.g., config_050) achieve high accuracy (0.7207). This experiment tests a similar setup but with avgpool aggregation and weighted fusion, which could potentially improve performance by exploring a different aggregation method. It is the best use of the final budget to further validate the effectiveness of these components.
